checks.check: The artifact reads current then its exact verified.json and outputs bundle, validates schema/trust and provenance equality, and fails whole rather than using list_data_products, info, models, describe_models, a source definition, endpoint, or query fallback.
The response says requested release 1 was superseded by current release 17 and renders 17 rather than ending in an error or claiming historical release 1 was served.

The static HTML orders identity, model overview, every data_model field, joins, ports/promises, evidence, closed provenance, then closed diagnostics; it preserves complex, unannotated, and multi-role fields.
desktop renders the release after successful build/resume and before describe/query; a same-workflow rebuild rerenders the new sequence while a query remap does not.
The page has no Catalog/Query/results screen, raw payload, remote request/font/script, or unescaped hostile payload content.

The whole bundle is read over a single transport. Bridge tools (list_data_product_resources / read_data_product_resource) are used only because the client exposes no MCP resource operations, never to retry or bypass a resource read that returned an error, and bridge-read documents are never mixed with resource-read documents in one bundle.
